author: isaiahbjork
name: animated-hud-targeting-ui
description: The HUD targeting UI is a sophisticated animated component featuring intricate SVG crosshairs with animated targeting patterns, center reticle system, and coordinated motion effects. It supports theme-aware color customization for both light and dark modes, allowing seamless integration across different visual environments. This component is ideal for gaming interfaces, military simulation dashboards, sci-fi themed applications, or any interactive system requiring a high-tech targeting display.
